page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance within the ecs.gn5 family, operating on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 CPU architecture. The hardware configuration features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 60.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 7.5 GB of memory per core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by two bundled NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering 32 GB of combined VRAM. Local storage includes a 944 GB local SSD, while networking performance provides a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

The density of two hardware graphics accelerators coupled with dedicated CPU cores and local SSD storage offers strong computational resource efficiency for accelerated workloads. Ideal applications include deep learning training and inference, high-performance computing (HPC), video encoding, and graphics processing.
